snippet.title: Coromon: Rogue Planet - MTD 2025
snippet.description:
Check out the brand new trailer for our upcoming title, Coromon: Rogue Planet! 🪐 This trailer originally aired during @GymLeaderEd's incredible 2025 Monster Taming Direct. 

Full of sneak peeks, lore, and new gameplay, this is the most we've revealed yet about the next game in the Coromon franchise. 

If you'd like to stay up to date on development and release news, please wishlist Rogue Planet on Steam!  👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195360

Learn more about Coromon here ⬇️
Website: https://www.coromon.com/
